components.name: Reader Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA on reader and shared patterns.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #ff6a00; color: #fff; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e63946; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e63946; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Admin Surface Card
components.css: .ds-surface { background: var(--surface-bg, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--surface-border, #e0e0e0); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-surface-inner { padding: 16px; }

components.name: Creator Episode Thumb
components.css: .ds-ep-thumb { border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-ep-thumb img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 5 / 8; object-fit: cover; display: block; }

narrative.overview: Warm reader storefront, focused creator studio, and clear operator moderation. Shared structure with per-app accent colors.

rules.name: The Panel Identity Rule
rules.body: Each shell keeps its own primary accent.

dos: Do use semantic CSS variables for new UI.
Do show real manga pages in review UIs.
donts: Don't use horizontal-only page review strips.
